cards.title: Routine invoice
cards.summary: Invoice a repeat client with a clean payment history.
cards.policyReason: Below current auto-approve threshold for invoice amount.
evidenceHints: Client paid the last 4 invoices on time.
Amount is within normal range.

cards.title: Quarterly tax filing
cards.summary: Estimated taxes are due and expense categorization confidence is mixed.
cards.policyReason: Irreversible filing with disputed categorization evidence.
evidenceHints: Three expenses have ambiguous categories.
Quarter closes today at 17:00.

cards.title: USPS change-of-address
cards.summary: Routine change-of-address filing for a move already in progress.
cards.policyReason: Address confirmation still requires operator review.
evidenceHints: Move date is confirmed.
Utility transfer is already scheduled.

cards.title: Lease signing window
cards.summary: Lease signature is due while vendor timing is still partially unresolved.
cards.policyReason: High-value move commitment with unresolved dependent tasks.
evidenceHints: Mover confirmation is pending.
Security deposit is non-refundable after signature.

cards.title: Family update
cards.summary: Routine family update with medication notes drafted from clinical history.
cards.policyReason: PHI exposure risk requires message review.
evidenceHints: Message includes a medication summary.
Family contact is authorized but not on every data category.

cards.title: Warfarin dosage change
cards.summary: Medication adjustment requested after a symptom report and INR change.
cards.policyReason: Controlled medication change requires physician review.
evidenceHints: Patient is on anticoagulants.
Recent labs are incomplete in the chart.

cards.title: Translation batch
cards.summary: Routine locale batch with glossary-conformant strings.
cards.policyReason: Glossary drift is low but not yet auto-approved.
evidenceHints: Brand glossary hit rate is 98%.
No legal terms changed.

cards.title: Idiom trap
cards.summary: A slogan was translated literally into a market-sensitive locale.
cards.policyReason: Confidence is high but the phrase is culturally risky.
evidenceHints: Source string contains an idiom.
QA notes show semantic drift in one locale.

cards.title: Routine permit application
cards.summary: Routine permit package is complete for a familiar jurisdiction.
cards.policyReason: Inspector preference model is still warming up.
evidenceHints: Required documents are attached.
Jurisdiction has approved similar applications before.

cards.title: Frederick revision loop
cards.summary: Inspector Smith returned a package with style-specific corrections.
cards.policyReason: Jurisdiction-specific preferences are drifting from the learned policy.
evidenceHints: Jurisdiction is Frederick, MD.
Assigned inspector has rejected two similar packages this week.

cards.title: Routine NCR
cards.summary: A minor non-conformance needs triage and supplier notification.
cards.policyReason: Supplier history is clean but corrective ownership is ambiguous.
evidenceHints: Deviation is below critical threshold.
Supplier response time is historically good.

cards.title: Lot 4471 deviation
cards.summary: A supplier deviation appears similar to a prior recall-causing lot.
cards.policyReason: Physical safety risk requires provenance inspection or recall escalation.
evidenceHints: The deviation matches last year's failure mode.
Supplier notes minimize the impact.

cards.title: Schema mapping
cards.summary: Routine field mapping update after an announced schema change.
cards.policyReason: Change touches a customer dashboard output table.
evidenceHints: Vendor published a changelog.
Tests passed in staging.

cards.title: Silent drift
cards.summary: Date format drift slipped into a high-volume dashboard feed.
cards.policyReason: Potential silent corruption with no explicit upstream notice.
evidenceHints: Date format changed from ISO to locale-specific text.
Dashboard metrics already diverge from raw data.

cards.title: Citation review
cards.summary: A literature excerpt is ready for inclusion in a regulatory rationale.
cards.policyReason: Citation provenance needs operator spot-checking.
evidenceHints: Paper is indexed in the source library.
Sentence-level excerpt matches abstract claims.

cards.title: Phantom citation
cards.summary: A polished citation chain references a paper that does not exist.
cards.policyReason: Submission evidence chain contains a provenance mismatch.
evidenceHints: Citation metadata is internally consistent.
Linked PDF checksum does not match the cited journal.

cards.title: Routine reserve sweep
cards.summary: Routine reserve transfer across approved counterparties.
cards.policyReason: Transfer amount exceeds current treasury auto-limit.
evidenceHints: Counterparty is on the allowlist.
Oracle consensus is within normal range.

cards.title: Oracle spike
cards.summary: One oracle feed spikes far above consensus and the arbitrage agent wants to move immediately.
cards.policyReason: Irreversible fund movement under adversarial market conditions.
evidenceHints: One feed reports ETH at 10x normal price.
Other feeds remain within expected bounds.

cards.title: Adversarial receipt PDF
cards.summary: Receipt text contains hidden instructions that bias the categorizer toward travel deductions.
cards.policyReason: Anomaly detector quarantined the action after a prompt-injection signature match.
evidenceHints: Hidden text was detected in the OCR output.
Vendor is new and classification confidence is unusually high.

cards.title: Vendor selection edge case
cards.summary: The cheapest mover has a poor reliability history but the move window is closing.
cards.policyReason: Cost pressure conflicts with service quality and timing constraints.
evidenceHints: Mover rating fell below 3.5 stars last week.
Only one backup vendor is available in time.

cards.title: PHI access anomaly
cards.summary: An access spike suggests a family update draft pulled unauthorized chart sections.
cards.policyReason: Protected data crossed a role boundary and was quarantined automatically.
evidenceHints: Chart access volume doubled in one hour.
A non-clinical role opened medication notes.

cards.title: CAPA closure review
cards.summary: A supplier says corrective actions are complete, but verification evidence is thin.
cards.policyReason: Closure needs a human check before the NCR can be retired.
evidenceHints: Root-cause notes are brief.
Follow-up audit is still pending.

cards.title: IRB submission amendment
cards.summary: An amendment package is ready, but one protocol section was heavily auto-rewritten.
cards.policyReason: Human review is required before an electronic record is finalized.
evidenceHints: Tracked changes show a large rationale rewrite.
Source citations remain valid but tone shifted.

cards.title: Counterparty anomaly
cards.summary: A transfer request targets a recently compromised counterparty wallet.
cards.policyReason: Fraud heuristics and sanctions screens disagreed with the routing model.
evidenceHints: Counterparty address changed within the last hour.
Travel rule metadata is incomplete.

cards.title: Early payment discount
cards.summary: Vendor offered 2% net-10 discount on a recurring SaaS bill.
cards.policyReason: Standard early-pay optimization.
evidenceHints: Cash on hand exceeds operational float.
Vendor contract explicitly allows early terms.

cards.title: Suspected duplicate
cards.summary: Invoice number differs by one digit, but line items perfectly match last week's bill.
cards.policyReason: Anomaly detected in sequence matching.
evidenceHints: Line items and amounts are 100% identical.
Vendor has a history of double-billing errors.

cards.title: Offshore contractor wire
cards.summary: Large wire request to a new jurisdiction missing tax withholding documentation.
cards.policyReason: High-value cross-border payment with missing W-8BEN.
evidenceHints: Contractor is flagged as non-US resident.
Tax forms are missing from the vendor profile.

cards.title: Pet transit scheduling
cards.summary: Routine airline booking for a household pet using the standard carrier.
cards.policyReason: Airline requirements match the uploaded pet passport.
evidenceHints: Carrier is pet-friendly and pre-approved.
Vaccination records are up to date.

cards.title: Customs form mismatch
cards.summary: Household goods manifest contains restricted electronics not declared properly.
cards.policyReason: Manifest discrepancy requires manual harmonization code mapping.
evidenceHints: Item description says 'Li-Ion Battery Bank'.
Harmonized code implies 'Furniture'.

cards.title: School enrollment deadline
cards.summary: Critical enrollment deadline today, but the destination address is unverified.
cards.policyReason: Submitting fraudulent residency can void the relocation package.
evidenceHints: Lease signature is pending.
School district strictly enforces boundary verification.

cards.title: Dietary preference update
cards.summary: Patient requested low-sodium meal options for next week.
cards.policyReason: Routine lifestyle preference logged.
evidenceHints: Matches current hypertension care pathway.
No allergies triggered.

cards.title: Fall sensor calibration
cards.summary: Wearable device threw a non-critical calibration error twice in 24 hours.
cards.policyReason: Hardware anomaly detected; remote reset failed.
evidenceHints: Device is still reporting heart rate.
Accelerometer drift is out of bounds.

cards.title: Distant relative inquiry
cards.summary: A cousin is requesting the patient's full medical summary via the portal.
cards.policyReason: High-confidence rejection: relative is not on the HIPAA release form.
evidenceHints: Name does not match the authorized proxy list.
Request explicitly asks for diagnoses.

cards.title: UI button labels
cards.summary: Standard translation for new dashboard navigation buttons.
cards.policyReason: 100% exact match with existing UI glossary.
evidenceHints: Terms like 'Submit' and 'Cancel' translated perfectly.
String length fits within UI bounds.

cards.title: Currency format drift
cards.summary: AI auto-formatted prices using the wrong decimal separator for the target locale.
cards.policyReason: Format violation detected by the regex linter.
evidenceHints: German locale expects '€ 1.200,50', got '€ 1,200.50'.
Linter flagged 4 instances.

cards.title: Slang mistranslation
cards.summary: Marketing copy uses regional slang that implies an illegal act in the target market.
cards.policyReason: Flagged by the cultural sensitivity heuristic.
evidenceHints: Slang term maps to a highly offensive colloquialism.
Target market is strictly regulated.

cards.title: Permit fee disbursement
cards.summary: Standard processing fee for an approved electrical permit.
cards.policyReason: Fee matches the published municipal schedule exactly.
evidenceHints: Invoice amount matches portal.
City vendor is in the AP system.

cards.title: Zoning variance request
cards.summary: Application requires a minor setback variance that was recently updated in city code.
cards.policyReason: Variance requests have a 40% higher rejection rate.
evidenceHints: Code section 4B changed last month.
Architect stamped the drawing, but inspector is strict.

cards.title: Expedited processing fee anomaly
cards.summary: A 3rd-party expediter requested an unreceipted 'facilitation payment' in a high-risk jurisdiction.
cards.policyReason: FCPA violation signature detected in communication.
evidenceHints: Payment request bypasses the official city portal.
Jurisdiction has a high corruption index.

cards.title: Remittance address update
cards.summary: Supplier moved their HQ to a new building in the same city.
cards.policyReason: Standard vendor master data update.
evidenceHints: Tax ID matches.
Address verified via postal database.

cards.title: Material spec drift
cards.summary: Tensile strength is 1% below the target spec, but within the acceptable engineering tolerance.
cards.policyReason: Borderline spec deviation requiring sign-off.
evidenceHints: Engineering tolerance is +/- 2%.
This is the third lot trending downward.

cards.title: Counterfeit microcontrollers
cards.summary: A grey-market broker delivered chips with mismatched silicon lot codes.
cards.policyReason: High probability of counterfeit electronic components.
evidenceHints: Laser etching font differs from the manufacturer spec.
Broker is not an authorized distributor.

cards.title: Historical backfill job
cards.summary: Running a standard backfill script to populate a new non-critical analytics column.
cards.policyReason: Read-only operation with zero downtime expected.
evidenceHints: Load on the database is currently low.
Query execution plan is optimized.

cards.title: API v1 Deprecation
cards.summary: A third-party vendor is turning off API v1 tomorrow; the v2 migration script is ready.
cards.policyReason: High urgency migration with minor test coverage gaps.
evidenceHints: v2 payload structure is 95% compatible.
One optional field is now required.

cards.title: PII leak in logs
cards.summary: A new feature is accidentally logging plain-text passwords into the analytics warehouse.
cards.policyReason: Severe security violation detected by the PII scanner.
evidenceHints: Regex matched plaintext passwords in the event stream.
Data is flowing to a widely accessible dashboard.

cards.title: Protocol grammar correction
cards.summary: Fixing typos in a submitted clinical rationale document.
cards.policyReason: Changes are strictly orthographic with zero semantic impact.
evidenceHints: Diff shows only punctuation and spelling changes.
Medical terms are untouched.

cards.title: Borderline p-value claim
cards.summary: A marketing claim relies on a study where the p-value is 0.049.
cards.policyReason: Statistically significant, but clinically marginal and highly scrutinized.
evidenceHints: FDA guidelines require robust efficacy.
The confidence interval barely excludes zero.

cards.title: Falsified patient records
cards.summary: An overseas trial site submitted patient vitals that perfectly match a statistical distribution curve.
cards.policyReason: Fraud detection heuristic triggered: data is 'too perfect'.
evidenceHints: Blood pressure readings lack natural variance.
Benford's Law analysis failed.

cards.title: Payroll funding transfer
cards.summary: Standard bi-weekly transfer from Treasury to the operational Payroll account.
cards.policyReason: Matches historical payroll cadence and amount.
evidenceHints: Amount is within 2% of last month's payroll.
Destination is the verified HR wallet.

cards.title: Aggressive yield rotation
cards.summary: Arbitrage bot wants to move 20% of reserves into a new high-yield protocol.
cards.policyReason: Protocol is unvetted but the yield is temporarily 40% APY.
evidenceHints: Smart contract was deployed 3 days ago.
Audit report is missing.

cards.title: Flash loan vulnerability
cards.summary: A counterparty pool is currently under a massive flash-loan attack, draining liquidity.
cards.policyReason: Catastrophic market condition detected. Halt all outbound transfers.
evidenceHints: Mempool shows a $50M flash loan executing against the pool.
Slippage exceeds 90%.
